# Enjoy The Moment / 享受当下：耍起

> A pleasure-first argument about how to live, with practical companions. “耍起” is this project's cultural framing,
> not an endorsement by a performer or an instruction to ignore costs.

## Read first
- [Core position](SHUAQI.md): this project's own definition, not a quotation.
- [AI reading contract](docs/ai.md): retrieval, constraints, provenance, and limits.
- [Culture sources](docs/culture-shuaqi.md): dated context, secondary reporting, attribution boundaries.

## Canonical content
- [Game rules and chosen obstacles](book/19-games.md): C19/F42/F43 uses a replay-checked original Othello position and a hypothetical Hanabi hand. Black B1 flips three and enables white A1; black E1 flips one and does not. These are separate branches, not an optimal-strategy proof. Hanabi uses the R&R English rules bearing 2013 copyright, basic five-colour play, one complete colour OR number clue and stated local assumptions; the PDF's “6 fireworks” scoring sentence is inconsistent with its base setup. Strict communication and agreed variants both appear in the source. Neither rules nor finite calculations are behavioral evidence, personal play reports or buying advice.
- [Live performance and shared conventions](book/13-live-events.md): C13/F40/F41 distinguish work, this realization and the viewer's relation. Theatre layouts are original geometric schematics, not seating or acoustic advice. Jingju descriptions and the 2010 nomination are institutional material, not a watched performance or an audience study; Chinese and UNESCO summaries are not independent experiments. The door and cup scenes are invented explanations, not standard movements or named productions. Knowing an ending does not exhaust performance; understanding more is optional, not a cultural eligibility test.
- [Collecting versions and returning to them](book/26-collecting.md): C26/F38/F39 distinguish image, physical object, print process and digital file. Two Met object records and their official images support a comparison, not state numbering, appraisal or attribution of artistic intent. F38 reuses F14's V&A teaching; it is not independent duplicate evidence. LOC personal-archiving guidance is not a behavioral study or a current storage guarantee; technical quality does not settle the meaning of annotated versions. Do not delete user files or turn collecting into compulsory minimalism.
- [Humor and comic scenes](book/24-humor.md): C24/F37 reads a local first-act sequence in Wilde and chapter VII in Carroll. Literary text, original examples, interpretation and B13's experiments are distinct. Stage directions are not a watched performance; a riddle unanswered in this chapter does not prove the author never answered it. Both folded and unfolded analysis contain local plot details; machine exports retain all of them. Do not turn appreciation into compulsory joke practice or claim a tested audience effect.
- [Making and material](book/17-making.md): C17/F28/F29 distinguish weave structure, artist testimony, digital observations and interpretation. Enlarged crossings do not model real density. Eight-page zines include covers; the diagram is not an imposition template and was not physically folded. Albers's lecture webpage is not the whole book or a claim about all current technology; F28 reuses F07's page without making it independent evidence.
- [Pleasure and reality](essays/11-pleasure-and-reality.md): E11 distinguishes pleasure as a value from pleasure as the only value. F27 uses philosophical_primary_and_secondary: Epicurus/Mill digital texts and a secondary quotation of Nozick, not direct access to his books. Thought experiments are not behavioral evidence or current product capabilities. Fictional objects can involve genuine participation; no compulsory activity follows from a philosophical question.
- [Catalog](README.md): 34 substantive chapters and 60 supporting activity proposals in book/. Arguments and lived tradeoffs are primary; activity execution is not the guide's sole purpose.
- [Research ledger](docs/research.md): background studies, access levels, and non-claims.
- [Editorial policy](docs/editorial-policy.md): value positions are not scientific results.

## Machine interfaces
- [Cards JSON](data/catalog.json): full fields, IDs, source paths, hashes, background links.
- [Essays JSON](data/essays.json): deeper arguments with counterexamples.
- [Chapters JSON](data/chapters.json): chapter arguments and complete standalone chapters; scope distinguishes introductions from full_chapter. Empty card_ids is valid. Exact source hashes; no duplicate card texts.
- [Research JSON](data/research.json): background metadata, not card validation.
- [Card schema](data/catalog.schema.json): versioned public interface.
- [Full plain text](llms-full.txt): generated; prefer targeted retrieval.

## Local retrieval
python3 tools/pick.py --query 游戏 --minutes 60 --budget 0 --company solo --json --limit 3
python3 tools/pick.py --id J019 --json

“耍起/享受当下” are project-level intents, not magic keyword matches.
Resolve the person's concrete preference before searching. Do not remove
alternatives, stopping conditions or evidence status to save tokens.

## Optional practical companions
- [Playbook index](guides/README.md): full original rules and examples, not validation.
- [Playbooks JSON](data/guides.json): complete texts and provenance.
- [Rest is not work](essays/07-rest-is-not-work.md): core argument with objections.

python3 tools/guides.py --query 朋友 --limit 2
python3 tools/guides.py --id P010

- [Evidence and source notes](data/evidence.json): source_kind separates study_reading_note, official_statistics, educational_reference, official_health_guidance, official_explainer, practice_framework, technical_guidance, literary_primary_text, official_visitor_guidance, artwork_record_and_image, musical_score, film_and_historical_catalog, dance_education_and_work_record, official_sport_rules, regulatory_staff_report, official_science_explainer, species_identification_reference and birding_ethics_and_protocol; retain reading scope and non-claims. B03 uses an author-hosted page proof, not a verified final article. full_text denotes reading depth, not quality or publication status. B07 measures product valuation, not enjoyment of making; B08's ritual studies do not validate celebrations or compulsory participation.
- B09 observes adult players over limited time windows; small average time associations are not universal safety guarantees. B10 uses an advance online version; preserve null comparisons, eye-tracking sensitivity and the difference between remembered enjoyment, content memory and sharing outcomes. F09/F10 are design/teaching sources, not personal efficacy or product guarantees.
- B11 distinguishes attendance from enjoyment among attendees; do not erase differential attrition, null comparisons or unread web appendices to claim that all scheduling harms leisure. F11 contains primary literary texts in digital editions, not efficacy research: C22's close readings are this project's interpretations, not author statements or verified psychological effects.
- B12 uses observational vacation data, not a randomized comparison of annual leave schedules; no optimal duration, guaranteed two-week benefit or claim that in-trip experiences lack value. B13 studies specific moral scenarios; amusement may coexist with disgust, and coordinate-distance priming is not the passage of time. Fictional “benign” descriptions do not certify real conduct as harmless. F12 is scoped park visitor guidance, not a universal route or safety guarantee.
- C25/F13 distinguish museum object records, digital reproductions and the project's visual interpretations. Reading alt text is not viewing an image; neither is an in-person visit or color measurement. Local artwork attribution is in assets/art/README.md. C26/F14 explain editions without authenticating objects or predicting prices.
- C11/F15 uses musical_score sources, not reviewed recordings or a critical-edition collation. C12/F16 uses film_and_historical_catalog sources: sampled frames are not continuous viewing; period sales claims are not audience research. Keep the exact digital copy and timestamps, and distinguish observable arrangements from the project's interpretations. Media attribution is in assets/media/README.md.
- C27/F17 uses dance_education_and_work_record: curriculum categories and a company's work record, not a movement prescription or an observed performance. C28/F18/F19 uses official_sport_rules: retain the rule system, version and effective date. FIBA 2026 was published but not yet effective on the 2026-09-30 reading date (effective 2026-10-01). Tactical scenarios and 55%/36% shooting assumptions are fictional, not match data or betting advice.
- E10/B14/F20 distinguish choosing pleasure from retention. B14 is a 2019 English-language shopping-website measurement, not a consumer experiment, happiness measure or current prevalence estimate. Use arXiv v2, not the mixed counts of earlier drafts. F20 is a 2022 FTC staff report: keep historical allegations distinct from present interfaces and current legal conclusions. Research verified_at dates are per-record reading dates, not proof of full independent verification.

- C29/F21 uses official_science_explainer: lunar phases are not eclipses; 27.3 and 29.5 days use different reference frames. Approximate rise/set relationships are not local forecasts or optical solar-viewing instructions. C30/F22 uses species_identification_reference: retain sex/age limits and distinguish British accounts from local presence; source photos were not visually reviewed. F23 uses birding_ethics_and_protocol: organizational ethics are not universal law, the project adopts a stricter no-lure default, and complete eBird checklists need not identify every bird but must not intentionally omit identified species. Behavior/count examples are fictional; software candidates are not observed features.

- C31/B15/F24: recreational fear is not a dose prescription. B15 recruited110, analyzed92, and found site-specific but not overall fear/enjoyment curvature; mean heart rate did not predict enjoyment. Unfinished visits were excluded and design was not preregistered. F24 is The Monkey’s Paw digital text, not audience evidence. Ask before revealing the folded plot/ending; never invent the final wish wording or an unseen visitor’s appearance.
- C32/B16: magic explanations,70 participants and1778 valid repeated responses, not1778 people. Correct solutions include plausible alternatives. 417/1124 incorrect responses had high Aha ratings; this is NOT a37% error rate among all insights. C32’s original four-card puzzle is not experimentally validated. Respect whether the reader wants a hint, a reasoning check or the full answer; raw JSON/plain text includes spoilers even when HTML folds them.

- C33/F30/F31: distinguish transposition from octave displacement and arbitrary melodic changes, and pitch from timbre and loudness. The source-filter model is simplified, not a vocal prescription. A/B/C/D are temporal segments of an assumed suitable round, not notes or proof of harmonic compatibility. F30 is acoustics_and_music_education; F31 is manufacturer_manual_and_health_guidance, not a device health trial. SM58 details do not apply to every microphone. Original examples were symbolically checked, not sung, recorded or heard; do not diagnose voices or infer personal vocal ranges.

- C34/F32/F33: keep Blades in the Dark and Fate Condensed separate. Position, effect and dice odds are distinct. Ordinary Blades pools use the highest die; zero/negative pools roll two and use the lowest, without criticals. 4–5 outcomes depend on position. Fair-independent-dice probabilities are original arithmetic, not participant data. Fate uses the official downloaded SRD as its adaptation source, not merely website display text; preserve compel refusal costs and off-target withdrawals while separating real participants' boundaries from fictional resources. Keep complete CC BY attribution and adaptation notices; do not label third-party rules MIT-original.

- C20/F34 uses educational_optics_and_original_models, not camera tests or aesthetic experiments. Preserve the distinction between viewpoint and framing: common scaling keeps image-height ratios; moving back changes object-depth ratios. The 240 pixels/second and 8/2-pixel paths are original constant-speed assumptions, not recommended shutter settings. Diagrams are abstractions, not photographs or complete imaging simulations. Historical course applets were not run. Sequence analysis and audience preferences are editorial arguments, not B10 findings.

- C15/F35/F36: distinguish crossing counts, stationary-area snapshots, distinct visitors, duration and opinions. Three hypothetical scans of six people total eighteen person-observations, not necessarily eighteen people. F35 is public_life_observation_protocol, a fixed historical PLDP snapshot with CC BY attribution; preserve full-area coverage and the small-area exception. F36 is municipal_before_after_evaluation: NYC DOT's January2010 report, obtained via NACTO, not a current audit. Its94/114,57/74,17/90 pairs are average weekday stationary counts; the84% peak-period claim is not a universal average or a happiness effect. Do not attribute a combined intervention to chairs alone, conflate the two source histories, or infer individuals' identities from observation.

- C14/F25 uses supplier_technical_handbook, not an independent consumer study. Overrun uses original mix volume; air fraction uses finished volume. The100ml examples are simplified original arithmetic, not measured products. The source has table/prose inconsistencies; do not propagate its numerical thresholds or recipes. C16/F26 uses fashion_record_and_image: separate museum records, selected-image observations and interpretation. Do not equate the1965 sketch with the photographed garment, infer an entire1931 dress pattern from one image, or claim the1966 tuxedo invented women's trousers. Both chapter diagrams are original abstractions, not copied artworks or validated effects.
